title: 第十六章 方公子欺负人
novel_title: 方彻刚刚更新内容(长夜君主)
content_zh: 事出突然，方彻两人都是愣了一下。两人注目看去，只见面前少女衣衫褴褛，身材瘦弱，一副常年营养不良的样子。头发干枯发黄，如同杂草。身材娇小，楚楚可怜。露出来的胳膊，足踝等部位，清晰可见被鞭子抽的一道一道的青紫。脸上满是污秽和伤口，但是却也能依稀看出来，面目很是秀丽。此刻双眼紧闭，昏迷不醒，七窍流血，看起来很是恐怖。瘦弱的身子下面，一大滩血迹，缓缓的泅出来。色泽暗红。显然，内脏摔伤了。但凡有些常识的人看到这一幕就知道，若是不及时救治，这个少女，绝对挨不过两个时辰。鲜血飞溅。有几滴，落在了方彻鞋子上。方彻低头，看着鞋上的血滴，脸上神色，有明显的震动。“不要管这些闲事。”孙元漠然。一条人命而已，在孙元眼中，不值得什么。就当做面前摔死了一只老鼠。“师父稍等。”方彻脸上有稚嫩的愧疚，轻声道：“刚看到那么多人死了，我……我看这个小姑娘，挺可怜的。”孙元转头皱眉看着他。但想起来他今天乃是第一次遭遇这种人间残酷，忍不住叹口气，道：“随你！”方彻低下头看着昏迷少女，一脸悲悯之色。一颗丹药送进了少女口中，喃喃道：“好可怜。”他抬头，看了一眼青楼上的满脸狰狞的汉子，看到他出手救助，顿时好几个人从楼上一跃而下。方彻心里顿时就有了数。镇守者，果然是对自己已经盯上了。而眼前这个少女，应该就是他们派来的，准备潜伏在自己身边的探子。他本来就在怀疑，因为这件事情太巧了。自己恰好走到这里，这少女就如此凄惨的摔在了自己面前。【只不过，也太下本了些。这伤势，可是一点也不假啊。】方彻心中感叹。但也骤然轻松了一些。既然本地镇守者之中，还有这样脑筋灵活的人物，那么自己未来，也能轻松一些。“把这個贱婢拖回去！”一个精壮的汉子一脸狰狞，咆哮说道。顿时如狼似虎冲上来两个大汉。方彻一抬脚，砰砰两声，顿时两个人化作了滚地葫芦。“阁下，这可是我金玉楼的家事！”那精壮汉子一皱眉，瞪着方彻，满脸不善：“你是什么人，竟然敢出头管我家闲事？”旁边围观者中，顿时有人叫起来：“这难道就是义薄云天、为朋友两肋插刀，生死一诺的方彻方公子？！”旁边人不懂，就问。于是就有人解释。方公子与苏越公子八拜之交，生死之盟，苏公子失踪，家族遭遇劫难，方公子如何义薄云天，如何肝胆相照，如何忠义冲天……顿时大家都多了几分敬意。原来这位方公子，竟然是如此人格伟大的人。难怪见不得不平事，看到这少女就感觉可怜。原来人家本来就是一个侠义之人啊，慈悲情怀啊。于是这件事急转直下，那些打手不敢动了。方彻淡淡道：“我只是看这个姑娘可怜，没有为难你们的意思，既然这事儿我遇到了，正好我身边还缺个侍女，可以叫你们掌柜的出来，多少钱，我买下来就好。”很快，青楼的管事与老鸨出来了，面对方彻很是尊敬。毕竟“义薄云天方公子”现在在碧波城名头很是响亮。虽然背地里大家都私自评论说什么的都有，但是真正面对的时候，却没有那么多不识趣的人。——不管怎么说，方彻能做到现在的地步，背后有什么让人细思极恐。谁敢触这样的霉头？方彻和善的说道：“这位姑娘，叫什么名字？多大了？我买了，多少钱？将她的卖身契拿来于我。”“这丫头名叫二丫，没有大名，前些天流落这里晕倒在门口，被我收留，今年十六了，本想着让这丫头……咳咳，没想到这丫头根本不念我们救命之恩……”方彻皱皱眉，淡淡道：“什么二丫，名字难听死了。从此以后，她叫夜梦。”“是，是，方公子取名字真好听，这丫头遇到方公子，也真是她的福气……”“少废话，多少钱？卖身契拿来。”“这个……要一千……”老鸨看着方彻温和的面容，却清冷的眼神，莫名感觉心中寒冷，一千两银子竟然感觉说不出口：“……三百……？”
content_en: When something happened suddenly, both Fang Che and Fang Che were stunned for a moment.The two of them looked at it and saw that the girl in front of them was in ragged clothes, thin and looked like she had been malnourished all year round.The hair is dry and yellow, like weeds.She is petite and pitiful.On the exposed arms, ankles and other parts, the bruises from the whip could be clearly seen.The face was covered with dirt and wounds, but it could still be vaguely seen that the face was very beautiful.At this moment, his eyes were closed tightly, he was unconscious, his orifices were bleeding, and he looked very scary.Under the thin body, a large pool of blood slowly swam out.Dark red color.Apparently, the internal organs were injured.Anyone with some common sense would know after seeing this scene that if she was not treated in time, this girl would never survive more than two hours.Blood splattered.A few drops fell on Fang Che's shoes.Fang Che lowered his head and looked at the blood drops on his shoes. There was obvious shock on his face."Don't mind these nosy matters." Sun Yuan was indifferent.It was just a human life, and in Sun Yuan's eyes, it was not worth anything.Just think of it as if a mouse fell to death in front of you."Master, wait a moment." Fang Che said softly with childish guilt on his face, "I just saw so many people dead. I... I think this little girl is quite pitiful." Sun Yuan turned to look at him with a frown.But remembering that today was the first time he encountered such cruelty in the world, he couldn't help but sigh and said, "It's up to you!" Fang Che lowered his head and looked at the unconscious girl with a look of compassion on his face.A pill was put into the girl's mouth and she murmured: "How pitiful." He raised his head and glanced at the ferocious-looking man in the brothel. When he saw him helping, several people jumped down from the building.Fang Che immediately knew something in his mind.The guardian has indeed set his sights on him.And the girl in front of him should be the spy they sent to lurk around him.He was already doubting it because it was such a coincidence.He just happened to walk here, and this girl fell miserably in front of him.[It’s just that it’s a bit too low-key.This injury is not fake at all.] Fang Che sighed in his heart.But he suddenly felt a little more relaxed.Since there are such flexible minds among the local defenders, I can feel more relaxed in the future."Drag this bitch back!" A strong man roared with a ferocious look on his face.Suddenly two big men rushed up like wolves and tigers.Fang Che raised his foot, and with two bangs, the two people turned into rolling gourds."Your Excellency, this is my Jinyulou's family matter!" The muscular man frowned and glared at Fang Che with an unkind look on his face: "Who are you to interfere in my family's business?" Someone among the onlookers nearby suddenly shouted: "Is this Mr. Fang Che who is righteous, goes out of his way to protect his friends, and promises life and death?!" People nearby asked because they didn't understand.So someone explained.Young Master Fang and Young Master Su Yue had known each other for eight years and formed a life-and-death alliance. Young Master Su disappeared and the family suffered a disaster. Young Master Fang was so righteous, so daring, and so loyal... Suddenly everyone had a little more respect.It turns out that Mr. Fang is such a great person.No wonder he felt pitiful when he saw this girl.It turns out that he was originally a chivalrous person with compassionate feelings.Then the matter took a turn for the worse, and the thugs did not dare to move.Fang Che said calmly: "I just see this girl as pitiful, and I don't mean to embarrass you. Since this happened to me, and I happen to be short of a maid, I can ask your shopkeeper to come out, and I will buy it for how much." Soon, the brothel's steward and the madam came out, and they were very respectful to Fang Che.After all, "Young Master Yibo Yuntianfang" is now very famous in Bibo City.Although everyone commented privately behind the scenes, there were not so many ignorant people when faced with it.——In any case, what is behind Fang Che's ability to achieve what he is now is terrifying to think about.Who dares to get into trouble like this?Fang Che said kindly: "What's this girl's name? How old is she? I bought it. How much did it cost? Give me her deed of sale." "This girl's name is Erya. She has no real name. She was living here a few days ago.I fainted at the door and was taken in by me. She is sixteen this year. I originally wanted to let this girl... ahem, but I didn't expect that this girl didn't appreciate our life-saving grace at all..." Fang Che frowned and said lightly: "What Erya?The name is so unpleasant.From now on, her name is Ye Meng."Yes, it's a good name for this girl. It's a blessing for this girl to meet Mr. Fang..." "No nonsense, how much is it for?""This... costs one thousand..." The madam looked at Fang Che's gentle face, but her eyes were cold, and she felt cold in her heart."...Three hundred...?"
